function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a shell command with /bin/bash -c inside /workspace. Commands time out after 300 seconds; stdout and stderr are truncated to 5000 characters. Returns JSON with status, stdout and exit_code, or an error with details.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file under /workspace with 1-indexed, inclusive line slicing. At most 150 lines and 10000 characters are returned per call; is_truncated reports when a limit was reached.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace old_string with new_string in an existing, non-empty file under /workspace. Tries exact, whitespace-flexible and regex matching in turn. Fails if old_string matches more than once unless allow_multiple is true. Returns the resulting diff.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file at /workspace/<filepath>, creating parent directories as needed.

function.name: submit_patch
function.description: Capture the current changes in /workspace (git add -N . && git diff HEAD) as the final patch and end the task once this turn finishes. Does not count toward the tool-call budget.

function.name: get_status
function.description: Return budget consumption (tool calls used and remaining, time remaining) and whether a patch has been submitted. Free; never fails because of the budget.
